meaning: An explicit versioned compilation selection joins authored implementation bindings to one checked DomainSpec project and its compiler-selected native representation profiles.
selection: Language, architectural profile, exact numeric realization and output layout are independent explicit fields. The candidate selects TypeScript, the existing profile layout and exact UInt64 values only. Unknown combinations reject rather than falling back to a legacy renderer.
bindings: Field references, factory validators, Operation action data and Workflow argument/result/recovery selections remain explicit authored data. The compiler derives graph, field, boundary, action and Workflow identity hashes from checked sources; the caller cannot provide source bytes, compiled snapshots, provider callbacks or digest overrides in this selection.
workflow: Authored Workflow call bindings identify existing step or compensation occurrences and provide their ordinary and Event arguments. Their Operation identity comes from the declared source occurrence. The compiler pins the corresponding freshly checked action; it does not reorder occurrences or invent calls. Recovery dependency semantics and tie-break remain explicit existing choices.
project_context: Check the whole project once. Its actual Entity, Value Object and Enum declarations form the common exact field context, or null when there are none. Every actual record has its explicit factory binding; every Operation and Workflow has exactly one authored binding. Unsupported source versions and incomplete coverage reject even if a later artifact view selects fewer roots.
generation: Select the existing generator from each declared metatype and source contract version, using only compiler-bundled definitions and profiles. Join all requests through the R07 immutable artifact planner. No second parser, inferred rule, new relationship or synthetic record is introduced.
artifact_view: A node selection is a projection of the same checked whole-project plan: start from modules owned by the exact qualified roots and include their transitive generated native imports. Graph references that do not cause native imports do not pull in executable modules. Selected bytes and paths are identical to project mode; source and semantic checking remains whole-project scoped.
effects: Source and snapshot APIs plan only. Local publication and verification remain separate boundaries. Reconciled selection does not execute Operation, Workflow, Policy, Event or provider behavior and does not change legacy defaults.
verification: whole-project graph and source APIs agree
all thirteen metatypes reach the shared plan
node artifact projection equals whole-project native import closure
authored bindings cannot revive checked identities
exact source removal and relocation behavior
unsupported versions and missing bindings reject without output writes
public commands and supported build combinations consume the same plan
